0.2.3 Change Log

  • Optimized the Admin system to eliminate unnecessary repetitive data processing during server startup and shutdown.
  • Added config options to enable or disable Admin features and customize Admin data collection.
  • Fixed an issue where DW and DWE were incorrectly displayed as DRM addons.
  • Fixed a bug with the Quest Editor's visibility settings.
